name: Wild celery & pondweeds
desc: Underwater plants rooted in the river bed. The FWS and Wikipedia describe submerged vegetation as important for fish and waterfowl. Canvasbacks eat the tubers.
about: Vallisneria americana, commonly called wild celery, water-celery, tape grass, or eelgrass, is a plant in the family Hydrocharitaceae, the "tape-grasses".
